notes.title: Stunt Paradise - Release! Our new racing game!
notes.content:
Our new game [b]Stunt Paradise[/b]! Now available on Steam, 15% off!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31595174/b16c2103caea4fb5a10ae6c406bf227b2b401199.png[/img]

It is an epic racing game with extreme driving and crazy challenges! 

The game fully supports Steam Deck, offering gamepad control with vibration, 120 FPS gameplay, achievements, cloud saves, and more! 🎉

Currently available on Windows and MacOS, we are also planning to introduce Linux support and localization for additional languages in the near future!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2435310/Stunt_Paradise/

Enjoy the game! 🙂

notes.title: Stunt Paradise - demo release! Our new game!
notes.content:
We are happy to announce a new game from our team!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32450335/0965956f467e2fbf28d688efd98b450989e84497.png[/img]

Stunt Paradise is an epic racing game with extreme driving and crazy challenges!
The Steam demo is out today, so you can play our game right now!

Push your driving skills to the limit as you perform insane stunts, including jumping off ramps, flipping through the air, and smashing through explosive obstacles!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2435310/Stunt_Paradise/

Stay tuned and add to the wishlist! 🙂

P.S. The Zombie Derby game series continues to be supported.

notes.title: Major update (remastered version)!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32450335/d5d9c6503a259b677d97ecc33a7ef5015bb1321f.png[/img]

[b]ZD1 Remastered is available on Steam![/b]

List of changes:
- New poster and icon.
- Improved graphics (textures, effects, shadows, models).
- Improved interface.
- Improved car physics.
- Improved car handling.
- Improved tutorial level.
- Improved game launch in "Big Picture" mode.
- Improved gamepad controls.
- Tactile effects (vibration).
- Many other technical fixes.

[b]Get 60% off on Zombie Derby: [/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/831770/Zombie_Derby/

Enjoy the game! 😎
